notes.title: 1.0.1 - Game Speed
notes.content: Added a "Game Speed" setting to allow players to set their preferred pace for most time-based mechanics in the game. Only available when selecting "New Game"

notes.title: Planet Scanner is here!
notes.content:
The slow-burn indie horror pretending to be a harmless job sim game is finally here! Pick up your copy of Planet Scanner and work hard for your corporate masters. And don't worry about what's going on in the rest of the universe. I'm sure everything will be JUST fine...

[previewyoutube=BmLC_cpAVEk;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you everyone for your amazing support. This is my first game ever, as well as being solo developed (though it wouldn't be what it is without my talented composer Stahmp). That being said, I couldn't have done it on my own.

This is for you guys. Enjoy and don't get too spooked.
